name: Shutter-access interlock interface
summary: Relates primary-contact shutter position to the documented access restrictions.
description: Relates primary-contact shutter position to the documented access restrictions. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Shutter and access conditions” at the input and “Access interlock status” at the output. The indication is not authorization to approach live contacts.
